Students must complete a minimum of 120 units with a cumulative and major/program grade point average of 2.0 in order to earn the bachelor of arts degree with a major in history.

Minimum 28 units and 9 courses that include:

","groupId":"16ec434e-6a36-4c0e-afa9-01948b015f58","position":3,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralTitle","content":"CORE Seminars (2 courses)","groupId":"ecb44ff9-8cfd-48c6-b69f-01948b020b99","position":4,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralText","content":"

1) CORE Seminars cannot be taken for Pass/No Credit. 

2) Transfer students with 28 or more transfer credits taken after high school are exempt from both CORE seminars.

","groupId":"c1e00693-6b73-49f4-9dda-01948b020b9a","position":5,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralTitle","content":" Breadth Requirement (7 courses, at least 3 units each)","groupId":"420e583c-bbba-4868-b99f-01948b03bf4b","position":6,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralText","content":"

Notes:

1) No more than 2 courses from a single discipline can be used to meet the Breadth Requirement.

2) Students must complete 60 units outside the primary discipline of the first major, regardless of the department who offers the course(s) in that discipline. (This includes general education courses, transfer courses, CPCE/EXTN units, internships, etc.).

All students must complete Diversity and Inclusion coursework (at least 3 units)

Notes:

1) Diversity and Inclusion courses can also be used to meet the breadth category requirements, or major or minor requirements.
